name: When should I consider relocating an outdoor gas line?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider relocating an outdoor gas line?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider relocating an outdoor gas line if it's obstructing a landscaping project, a new patio installation, or if you're adding an outdoor kitchen or fire pit in a new location. Other reasons include improving safety by moving a line away from high-traffic areas or protecting it from potential damage. It's important to assess the current line's exposure and proximity to new outdoor structures or activities during your planning phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Relocate an outdoor gas line if it obstructs landscaping, new construction, or to add outdoor appliances, or for safety improvements.
